title: Redesign asymmetric ops as one-shot ioctls
description: SIGN/VERIFY/AGREE operations currently misuse the write/read pipe. SIGN requires write(digest) then read() which returns 0 bytes then GET_SIG — undiscoverable and inconsistent with every other op. VERIFY requires SET_SIG before write(digest), semantically backwards. Replace all three with self-contained one-shot ioctls that take input and produce output in a single syscall. Also removes SET_SIG (slot 6) and GET_SIG (slot 7) from the dispatch, marking those numbers RESERVED. INIT op codes SIGN/VERIFY/AGREE are removed — INIT is now symmetric and hash only.
acceptance_criteria: DO_SIGN ioctl: takes algo+key_fd+digest → returns sig. DO_VERIFY ioctl: takes algo+key_fd+digest+sig → returns 0 or -EBADMSG. DO_AGREE ioctl: takes algo+key_fd+peer_pub → returns raw Z. No INIT required for asymmetric ops. SET_SIG and GET_SIG dispatch removed. All provider ops structs updated. Docs updated.
